title: Profile
measuredSince: Time measured since {{date}}. Existing play counts are retained.
measurementStarts: Listening time starts with your next play.
loadFailed: Could not load your listening profile.
noFavorites: Star songs in your Library to keep them here.
noPlays: Your played songs will appear here.
noHistory: Recent listening appears after you start playing.
measurementNote: Only measured playback time is counted. Pauses, buffering and seek jumps are excluded. Earlier play counts do not imply listening time.
noObservations: Detailed statistics will appear as you listen.
lifetimeNote: These totals include older play counts and are not affected by the period or device filters. Favorites are the current library selection.
trendNote: Measured activity for the selected period and device.
chartInstructions: Use the left and right arrow keys to inspect values; Home and End move to the first and last value.
localTimeNote: Hours and days follow the recorded listening timestamps.
noPeriodActivity: No measured listening in this selection.
noChartActivity: No measured activity to chart in this selection.
trackUnavailable: Audio unavailable; listening history is preserved.
noSessions: No recorded sessions in this selection.
sessionRangeNote: Session details retain their full recorded timeline. Selection totals count only activity inside the selected period.
volumeNote: App volume is not system or speaker volume. Unrecorded levels remain unknown.
noVolumeData: No volume-duration observations in this selection.
intervalNote: Each row is measured advancing playback with the settings recorded for that interval.
noIntervals: Interval settings were not recorded for this session.
noEvents: Playback events were not recorded for this session.
favoritesNote: Current library favorites. Listening figures follow the selected period and device; lifetime plays are labeled separately.
chartCoverage: {{time}} of earlier measured listening has no detailed time placement and is not shown in these charts.

hints.period: Choose which time range the statistics below cover.
hints.device: Show only listening that happened on one device.
hints.listeningTime: How long music was really playing; pauses and loading time are not counted.
hints.totalPlays: How many times a song was started and actually played; each start counts once.
hints.uniqueTracks: How many different songs you listened to.
hints.uniqueArtists: How many different artists you listened to.
hints.activeDays: On how many different days you listened to something.
hints.completed: Plays that reached the end of the song.
hints.skipped: Plays you left before the song finished, for example by pressing next.
hints.repeatPlays: Songs started while Repeat One was switched on.
hints.pauses: How many times you paused the music.
hints.seeks: How many times you jumped to another point in a song.
hints.averageSession: The average listening time of one song play.
hints.longestSession: The longest time you listened to a single song play.
hints.trends: How much you listened on each day of the selected range.
hints.hourPattern: Which hours of the day you listen the most.
hints.weekdayPattern: Which days of the week you listen the most.
hints.timeMetric: Charts show how long you listened.
hints.playsMetric: Charts show how many songs you played.
hints.volume: How long you listened at each volume of this app; muted time is listed separately.
hints.deviceActivity: How long you listened on each device you use.
hints.search: Type to narrow down the list below.
hints.sort: Choose how the list is ordered.
hints.sessions: Each time this song was played, with when and on which device.
hints.intervals: Stretches of uninterrupted listening, each with the settings that were active.
hints.events: Things that happened during playback, such as play, pause or seek, in order.
hints.recordDetails: Technical identifiers of this record, only needed for troubleshooting.
hints.sessionStatus: Whether this play finished, was skipped, or was stopped.
hints.album: The album this song belongs to.
hints.genre: The genre saved with this song.
hints.trackDuration: How long the whole song is.
hints.firstPlayed: The first time this song was played in the selected range.
hints.lastPlayed: The last time this song was played in the selected range.
hints.appVolume: The volume set inside this app, not your computer or speaker volume.
hints.systemVolume: The volume of your device itself; it is not recorded, so it stays unknown.
hints.playbackRate: How fast the song was playing; 1× is normal speed.
hints.shuffle: Whether songs were being played in random order.
hints.repeat: Whether the song or the queue was set to repeat.
hints.position: The point in the song where this happened.
hints.previousPosition: The point in the song you jumped from.
hints.rowTime: How long you listened in the selected range.
hints.rowPlays: How many times it was played in the selected range.
hints.lifetimePlays: All plays ever counted, regardless of the selected range.

views.tracks: Your songs, ranked by how long you listened.
views.artists: Your artists, ranked by how long you listened.
views.albums: Your albums, ranked by how long you listened.
views.genres: Your genres, ranked by how long you listened.
views.favorites: Songs you starred in your Library.
views.history: Every play in order, newest first.

eventKinds.seek: You jumped to another point in the song.
eventKinds.skip: You moved on before the song finished.
eventKinds.ended: The song played all the way to its end.
eventKinds.shuffle: You switched shuffle on or off.
